source_claim: Source distinguishes Rohru, Rampur, Baghi, Surkhuli Pargana and Dodra Kuar under generic Koci. Rampuri lies north of the Simla ridge, from east of Nirth on Satlaj to mile92½ on Hindostan–Tibet road; Satlaj generally north boundary. Baghi area extends5–6miles each direction around Baghi. Historical area claims, not new exact site coordinates.

source_claim: Royal Asiatic Society transliteration. Macron distinguishes length, unaccented vowels may be printed with or without it; breve vowels generally differ in quality. ă compared to u in but, ĕ nearly ē but shorter/probably lower, ŏ to hot, ŭ to pull versus root, lips usually not protruded/drawn together. Preserve printed marks, no editorial harmonization or invented IPA.
